title: Tech Note: [3rd Party Tech Note] Migrating Away from the 4D Picture Library
author: David Adams

historical_commentary.text: This note documents 4D's own long-running, deliberate deprecation of the Picture Library in favor of external picture files, a direction that has only strengthened over the subsequent decade; the guidance, migration utilities, and missing-file handling patterns remain directly applicable today, and any database still relying on the Picture Library should still follow essentially this same migration path.
related_updates: Continued 4D guidance favoring external picture/file references over any embedded binary picture storage
Modern 4D picture handling in Project Mode, which has no equivalent to the old resource-based Picture Library at all
